title: Personal-Customer Credit on Paloma Business Early Termination
content:
The owner's Personal Sender Account, the owner's personal account with Paloma Remit, decides a personal-customer credit on the early termination charge of a Paloma Business downgrade, read from its status and the date it was opened.

### Credit clause

An active Personal Sender Account opened 60 or more whole months before the day the downgrade is scheduled earns a personal-customer credit of 100.00 USD; an active Personal Sender Account opened 24 to 59 whole months before earns 40.00 USD; an owner with no active Personal Sender Account, or with one opened fewer than 24 whole months before, earns none.

The credit is a fixed amount in US dollars deducted from the early termination charge once the gross termination charge has been reduced by its percentage discounts, if any, and rounded half up to the cent; the charge after the deduction is never below 0.00 and is rounded half up to the cent.

### Bands

| Owner's Personal Sender Account | Whole months from its opening to the day the downgrade is scheduled | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| Active | 60 or more | 100.00 USD |
| Active | 24 to 59 | 40.00 USD |
| Active | Fewer than 24 | None |
| Not active, or none | Any | None |

### Cases (hypothetical)

- Personal Sender Account opened 1 June five years before the day the downgrade is scheduled, also a 1 June, and active: 60 whole months, 100.00 USD.
- Opened 2 June of that year instead: 59 whole months, 40.00 USD.
- Opened 30 months earlier but locked or closed, so not active: none.
